THE allotment specified in the Order No. 308 of 2014 made underthe Proviso (a) to Section 38 of the Land Acquisition Act(Chapter 460) and published in the Gazette Extra OrdinaryNo. 1887/41 dated 07.11.2014 is vested absolutely in the State andthe possession of which has been taken for or on behalf of the Stateunder Para (a) of Section 40 of the aforesaid Act. But by the virtue ofpowers vested in me by Sub-section (1) of Section 39(a) (inserted byAct, No. 8 of 1979) of the Land Acquisition Act. I, GayanthaKarunatilleke, Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,do hereby divest only the alltoment described in the Schedule Ibelow.
Gayantha Karunatilleke,Minister of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms.
My Ref. No.: 4-3/10/2012/LRB/324-II.Acquiring Officer No.: WRSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/16.Ministry of Lands and Parliamentary Reforms,“Mihikatha Medura”,Rajamalwatta Avenue,Battaramulla.18th October, 2019.
